Video to GIF Converter

Turn any short video clip into an animated GIF. Choose clip length, frame rate and width — frames are captured and encoded right in your browser.

Best for short clips of a few seconds. Longer clips, high frame rates or large widths use a lot of memory and take longer to encode. Your video never leaves your device.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a video file from your device.
  2. Set the clip length (seconds), frame rate and output width.
  3. Click "Convert to GIF" and wait while frames are captured and encoded.
  4. Your animated .gif downloads automatically when it is ready.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why are there limits on clip length and size?

GIFs store every frame as an image, so long clips get huge fast. This tool caps clips at 10 seconds, 15 fps and 480 px wide to keep files usable.

Where does the GIF go when it is ready?

The animated GIF downloads automatically as a .gif file once encoding finishes. Larger settings take longer to encode.

Is my video uploaded anywhere?

Yes — the video is read frame-by-frame on your device and the GIF is encoded locally. Nothing is uploaded.
